description: Aspire's minimum supported .NET version is raised to .NET 10: shipping libraries and C# templates now target `net10.0`/`net11.0` and no longer support .NET 8 or .NET 9. `dotnet new aspire-starter --framework` now only accepts `net10.0` or `net11.0`, defaulting to `net10.0`. Applications targeting .NET 8 or .NET 9 must upgrade before adopting this major version's library packages.
name: Raise Aspire's minimum supported .NET version to .NET 10
